dialogue.origin: こんにちは。相談員です。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか。
dialogue.content: Hello. I’m the counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: こんにちは妹の件で悩んでいます
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm struggling with something concerning my younger sister.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 妹が亡くなり中々立ち直れません
dialogue.content: My younger sister passed away, and I'm having a hard time moving on.

dialogue.origin: まぁ。それはお辛いですね。。。
dialogue.content: Oh, I'm so sorry to hear that. That must be incredibly difficult.

dialogue.origin: 仕事をしていても涙が突然出てきたりします
dialogue.content: I find myself suddenly crying, even at work.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。うんうん。
dialogue.content: I see. Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 気持ちの整理がつかずどうしたら良いものかと思って相談する事にしました。
dialogue.content: I haven't been able to process my feelings and wasn't sure what to do, so I decided to come talk to someone.

dialogue.origin: とても今お辛い中ご相談にきていただいてありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in to talk, especially when you're going through such a painful time.

dialogue.origin: もしよかったらどんな妹さんだったのか教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: If you're comfortable, would you mind telling me a little about your younger sister?

dialogue.origin: 亡くなる前は家族から煙たがられていました
dialogue.content: Before she passed away, the family found her difficult to deal with.

dialogue.origin: まぁ、そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: Oh, I see. So that's how it was.

dialogue.origin: 干渉されることを嫌う子でした
dialogue.content: She was someone who didn't like to be interfered with.

dialogue.origin: ご自分の世界をもっていらっしゃる感じでしょうか。
dialogue.content: It sounds like she had a world of her own.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: やることなすこと、とんちんかんで
dialogue.content: Everything she did was a bit off the mark.

dialogue.origin: というと例えば。。。
dialogue.content: Could you give me an example?

dialogue.origin: 仕事を一生懸命やろうとしても人間関係で上手くいかず仕事を変わってばかりでした。
dialogue.content: She would try to work hard, but she'd struggle with relationships at work and was always changing jobs.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see, so that's what was happening.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに
dialogue.content: By the way,

dialogue.origin: 妹さんは生前、あなたと一緒にくらしておられたのですね
dialogue.content: Your sister was living with you before she passed, is that correct?

dialogue.origin: 別です
dialogue.content: No, we lived separately.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: I see. Thank you for clarifying.

dialogue.origin: 妹さんは、あなたにとってどんな存在でしたでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What did your younger sister mean to you?

dialogue.origin: 腹はたっても、大切な妹でした。
dialogue.content: Even when I was angry with her, she was my precious younger sister.

dialogue.origin: きっと、そうですよね。だからこそ、仕事中も涙があふれてくるほど悲しいのですものね。
dialogue.content: Of course. And that's precisely why the grief is so overwhelming that it brings you to tears even at work.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: なにか妹さんとの思い出でわすれられないものとか、どんな感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Do you have any memories with your younger sister that stand out?

dialogue.origin: よかったらおはなしくださいませ。
dialogue.content: Please feel free to share, if you're comfortable.

dialogue.origin: 忘れられないというと、母と私が亡くなっているのを発見したので、目に焼き付いて離れません。良い思い出はあまりないので。
dialogue.content: Speaking of unforgettable... my mother and I were the ones who found her after she passed away, and the image is seared into my mind and won't leave. I don't really have many good memories.

dialogue.origin: まぁ、そうだんたのですか？
dialogue.content: Oh, is that so?

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですか。。。
dialogue.content: Is that what happened...

dialogue.origin: どんな感じでなくなられていたのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What was the situation like when you found her?

dialogue.origin: 自殺をしたわけではなく餓死状態でした。
dialogue.content: It wasn't suicide; she had starved to death.

dialogue.origin: えっ
dialogue.content: Oh...

dialogue.origin: 拒食症でしたので
dialogue.content: She had anorexia.

dialogue.origin: まぁ、そうだったのですね
dialogue.content: Oh my, I see.

dialogue.origin: それは、相当ショックですね
dialogue.content: That must have been an incredible shock.

dialogue.origin: 理解をしてやれなかった事が無念です
dialogue.content: My biggest regret is that I couldn't understand her.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。。。それは後悔してもしきれないくらい悔しいですよね。。。
dialogue.content: I understand... That must be a regret so painful you can't even begin to express it...

dialogue.origin: 自分を許せないです。
dialogue.content: I can't forgive myself.

dialogue.origin: そうお感じになっているのですね。くるしいですね。
dialogue.content: So that's how you're feeling. That must be agonizing.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。気力が出てこなくて。
dialogue.content: Yes. I just don't have any energy.

dialogue.origin: 何も手につかないかんじになってしまいますよね。
dialogue.content: I can imagine it makes it feel impossible to focus on anything.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, it does.

dialogue.origin: そんなお辛い中、申し訳ありませんがもう少し、亡くなる前の妹さんの状態について教えていただけますか？なにか変化があったとか。。。
dialogue.content: I know this is difficult, but would it be alright if I asked a little more about your sister's condition before she passed? Were there any changes...?

dialogue.origin: 高校生の頃から独り暮らしがしたいと行ってアパートで暮らし始めました。
dialogue.content: Ever since she was in high school, she said she wanted to live alone and started living in an apartment.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そこから家族と歯車が狂い始めたように思います。
dialogue.content: I think that’s when things started to go out of sync with the family.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 妹さんとの行き来は、どんなかんじだったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What was the interaction like between you and your younger sister?

dialogue.origin: 母は良く見に行っていました
dialogue.content: My mother often went to check on her.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 運動も勉強もとにかく一番で先生同士が取り合いになるくらいでした
dialogue.content: She was number one in both sports and academics, to the point where teachers would fight over her.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。とても頑張り屋さんだったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. She must have been a very hard worker.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、でも高校もあまりいかなくなり母が私に一緒に行くようよく言われたので私もよくみには行きました。
dialogue.content: Yes, but she started skipping high school, and my mother often asked me to go with her, so I went to see her often too.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですか。ちなみに高校に行かなくなったのは何かきっかけがあったのでしょうか
dialogue.content: I see. By the way, was there any particular reason she stopped going to school?

dialogue.origin: 部活の先生と校長が妹を取り合うはめになったぐらいでしょうか
dialogue.content: Maybe it was because her club coach and the principal ended up fighting over her.

dialogue.origin: 運動と勉強の板挟みになり、妹さんも辛くなってきてしまったのでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Caught between sports and academics, your sister may have found it difficult.

dialogue.origin: そうだと思います。でも１番の原因は家族が妹を理解出来なかったことかもしれません。
dialogue.content: I think so. But the biggest reason might be that our family couldn't understand her.

dialogue.origin: そう思われるのですね。
dialogue.content: So that's what you believe.

dialogue.origin: 理解できなかったと。
dialogue.content: That you couldn't understand her.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。この家族でなかったらまだ生きていたかもと、いつも思います。
dialogue.content: Yes. I always think that if she had been born into a different family, she might still be alive.

dialogue.origin: そうあなたが思われる真意には何か、ご家族との関係性が見え隠れするように感じるのですすが。。。もしよかったら、お話ししてくださいますか？
dialogue.content: When you say that, I get the sense there's more to the family relationships... If you're willing, would you mind telling me more about that?

dialogue.origin: 妹がやることなすこと、それは違うこうだよと私は私の考えを押し付けていました。
dialogue.content: Whatever my sister did, I would tell her, 'That's wrong, do it this way,' and force my own ideas on her.

dialogue.origin: 家族も生きるのに必死でしたし
dialogue.content: Our family was also just struggling to get by.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。。。
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: ご両親ももしかしたら厳しいタイプでしょうか
dialogue.content: Were your parents perhaps the strict type?

dialogue.origin: いえ全く、心を重視していましたが、とにかく生きるのに必死で自分の事は自分で解決するのが当たり前の家庭でした。
dialogue.content: No, not at all. They valued emotional well-being, but they were so focused on surviving that we were a family where everyone was expected to solve their own problems.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。。。
dialogue.content: I understand...

dialogue.origin: 寂しかったんだと思います。
dialogue.content: I think she must have been lonely.

dialogue.origin: えぇ。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 仕方がない事ですが。
dialogue.content: It couldn’t be helped, though.

dialogue.origin: ご両親も今は大変お辛い毎日をお過ごしでしょうね。
dialogue.content: Your parents must also be going through very painful days now.

dialogue.origin: 父はすでに他界しましたが心配していたと思います。
dialogue.content: My father has already passed away, but I'm sure he was worried about her.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 拒食は治療していたのですか？
dialogue.content: Was she receiving treatment for her anorexia?

dialogue.origin: どこかの病院とかで。
dialogue.content: At a hospital or somewhere, for instance?

dialogue.origin: 病院へ連れていっても突然姿をくらまして、行方がわからなくなったりで
dialogue.content: Even when we took her to the hospital, she would suddenly disappear, and we wouldn't know where she was.

dialogue.origin: まぁ。そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: Oh my. I see.

dialogue.origin: 治療も出来ませんでした
dialogue.content: We weren't able to get her treated.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。。。
dialogue.content: I understand...

dialogue.origin: 妹さんはお姉さんであるあなたをどのように思って生活していたのでしょうか
dialogue.content: How do you think your sister viewed you, her older sister?

dialogue.origin: 恐い人としか思っていなかったと思います。親を苦しめてと言って良く説教ばかりしていましたから。
dialogue.content: I think she probably just saw me as a scary person. I was always lecturing her, telling her she was making our parents suffer.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。。。
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 兄弟は、おふたりの姉妹だったのですね
dialogue.content: So it was just the two of you sisters?

dialogue.origin: 兄がいます。
dialogue.content: I have an older brother.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。お兄さんもショックの毎日をきっと送っていらっしゃいますね。
dialogue.content: I see. Your brother must be in shock and having a difficult time as well.

dialogue.origin: いえ、兄夫婦は厄介者が死んだ位の気持ちでしたから。
dialogue.content: No, for my brother and his wife, it was more like a burden had been lifted.

dialogue.origin: まぁ、そうなんですね。兄弟間の交流も希薄な感じだったのですね。。。
dialogue.content: Oh, I see. It sounds like the siblings weren't very close...

dialogue.origin: そうですね。
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。でも、あなたは、まさか自分の妹さんが拒食で命を落とすとは夢にも思っていなかったかんじですよね。
dialogue.content: I see. But you never dreamed that your younger sister would lose her life to anorexia, did you?

dialogue.origin: どこかで父があの世で助けてくれるかもなんて思ってました。馬鹿げていますが。
dialogue.content: A part of me thought that maybe our father would help her from the other side. It sounds foolish, though.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ。そんなことはありません。
dialogue.content: No, no. Not at all.

dialogue.origin: ここでいったんご相談の内容をまとめてもよろしかったでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Would it be alright if I took a moment to summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.origin: それとももう少しお話しされますか？
dialogue.content: Or would you prefer to talk a little more?

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です
dialogue.content: That's fine.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: たったひとりの大切な妹さんを拒食症という残念な形で、発見し
dialogue.content: You found your only, precious younger sister after she tragically passed away from anorexia,

dialogue.origin: 姉としてもっと妹さんの寂しかった気持ちに寄り添ってあげれたら、もっと生きていたかもしれないと自分を責めて
dialogue.content: and you are blaming yourself, thinking that if you, as her older sister, had been more present for her loneliness, she might still be alive,

dialogue.origin: 今、仕事も手につかないくらいの悲しみで動けなくなってご相談にいらしてくださった。
dialogue.content: and you have come in for counseling today, paralyzed by a grief so profound you can't even focus on work.

dialogue.origin: ご両親も生きるのに精いっぱいで姉としても「親に迷惑をかけないように」と怒ることもあった
dialogue.content: Your parents were doing all they could just to get by, and you, as her older sister, would sometimes get angry, telling her, 'don't cause trouble for our parents'.

dialogue.origin: そんな中でも妹さんを治療に病院へ連れて行ったり
dialogue.content: Despite all that, you took your sister to the hospital for treatment,

dialogue.origin: こうして亡くなった後ももっとできることがなかったのかと後悔していらっしゃるとてもお優しい気持ちを持っていると私は感じました。
dialogue.content: and I feel that your regret now, wondering if there was more you could have done, shows what a very kind heart you have.

dialogue.origin: 有り難うございます。妹が亡くなってから母とも妹の事について話をした事がなくて、話せたことが嬉しかったです。
dialogue.content: Thank you. I haven't talked with my mother about my sister since she passed away, so I'm glad I was able to talk about it.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。本当にお辛い中よくご相談にいらしてくださりました。
dialogue.content: I see. I'm truly glad you came in to talk, especially during such a painful time.

dialogue.origin: 有り難うございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 大切な肉親を、そういった形で亡くされたあとの悲しみは、言葉につくせないほどの苦しみ、痛みを伴うと思います。
dialogue.content: The grief after losing a beloved family member in such a way comes with suffering and pain beyond words.

dialogue.origin: お母さまもきっと、おひとりで抱えきれないほどの痛みをもっていらっしゃると思います。
dialogue.content: I'm sure your mother is also carrying a pain that's too much to bear alone.

dialogue.origin: 今頃、大切な妹さんは、天国で、お父さんと再会できているでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I wonder if your dear younger sister has been reunited with your father in heaven by now.

dialogue.origin: きっと逃げ回っているかもしれません
dialogue.content: She's probably running away from him.

dialogue.origin: そうかもしれませんね。。。。。
dialogue.content: Perhaps you're right...

dialogue.origin: なにか生前妹さんが好きだったお菓子や果物など仏壇にそなえてみてもいいかもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: It might be nice to offer some sweets or fruit that your sister liked at the family altar.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。母にはもう心配しなくて良いよ、あとはお父さんに任せようと言ってみます。
dialogue.content: Yes, you're right. I'll try telling my mother, 'You don't have to worry anymore; let's leave the rest to Dad.'

dialogue.origin: 有り難うございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 気持ちの整理が出来そうです
dialogue.content: I think I can start to sort out my feelings now.

dialogue.origin: それはよかったです。妹さんを大切に思うお優しい気持ちがきっと天国に通じると思います。今日は、お辛い中、ご相談にきていただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: I'm glad to hear that. I'm sure your kind and caring feelings for your sister will reach her in heaven. Thank you for coming to speak with me today, especially during such a difficult time.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ有り難うございました。
dialogue.content: No, thank you.

dialogue.origin: それではここで相談を終わりにしたいと思います。またなにかありましたらいつでもいらしてください。お体にお気をつけてお過ごしください。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Well then, I'd like to conclude our session here. Please feel free to come back anytime if anything else comes up. Please take care of yourself. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 有り難うございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました。終了しますね）
dialogue.content: (Thank you. I'll end the session now.)

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

topic.sub: 亡くなった妹への喪失感と自己責任感
